params.body:
The companion of control#63. Vera's review hand may invite a person and seal a root, and neither can be taken back: an invitation is mail that has been sent, a seal is anchored. Until now both rode on a word that named a period, "admitted on this project until 23:59", which a machine holding the hand key could spend as often as it liked inside the window.

- `ReviewHand::PER_ACTION` names `review.invite` and `review.sign`, and the grant carries it.
- Publishing keeps its window on purpose: a page can be published again, and the judgements survive it, so the cost of a touch of the key per publish buys nothing.

The gateway then requires a capability naming that exact act, and spends it on use.
params.title: Uitnodigen en zegelen vragen het woord voor die ene daad
